```python

    pos=models.FloatField(blank=True,null=True, type=float)
    neg=models.FloatField(blank=True,null=True, type=float)
```

Now the types of `pos` and `neg` are specified as `type=float`, which means that they can only take on the values that the `float` type can take on.
